sourceText: Omar sends to Priya.
justification: send lacks the thing sent (required theme).

sourceText: Lena publishes.
Marta allows Jonas to edit.
justification: permission names permitter and permittee but the edited object is missing.

sourceText: The admin forbids Sam to delete.
justification: prohibition with bare verb; deleted object missing.

sourceText: Nadia is permitted to read the payroll report.
justification: complete permission; permitter is legitimately unstated, should not be invented.

sourceText: Guests may use the lobby printer.
justification: deontic 'may' with no permitter; complete action.

sourceText: Contractors must not open the server cabinet.
Tom is not allowed to approve his own expenses.
Ingrid defenestrated the quarterly forecast.
justification: figurative verb with no plausible standard predicate; should not be forced.

sourceText: The committee glorped the budget.
Switch on the hallway lights.
justification: synonym of enable/turn on; complete command.

sourceText: Wipe the staging database.
Start the backup job.
Disable two-factor login for the test account.
Retry the upload 3 times on 2026-10-05.
justification: complete retry with count and date.

sourceText: If the battery is below 15 percent, then turn off Bluetooth.
Ο Νίκος στέλνει στη Μαρία.
Η Άννα επιτρέπει στον Γιώργο να επεξεργαστεί.
justification: permission with bare verb; edited object missing.

sourceText: Η Ελένη επιτρέπεται να διαβάσει το συμβόλαιο.
Οι επισκέπτες δεν πρέπει να μπαίνουν στο εργαστήριο.
Άναψε τα φώτα της κουζίνας.
justification: synonym of turn on/enable; complete command.

sourceText: Ο Κώστας δημοσίευσε την αναφορά στο ιστολόγιο.
Απενεργοποίησε τις ειδοποιήσεις για το ημερολόγιο.
Αν η μπαταρία είναι κάτω από 20 τοις εκατό, τότε κλείσε το Wi-Fi.
